criteria.criterion: docs/design/requirements-map.md covers every requirement in BRIEF.md as rows with IDs, each marked covered, partial, or not covered, replacing the sample table.
criteria.evidence: I read the map. It has 124 ID'd rows (OM, EN, SD, A1–A13, S1–S7, D1–D3, OR, JG, AD) covering the operating model, the sandbox, standards, boundaries, Parts 1–3, the order, the judging bullets and all eleven addenda. Each row is marked Covered, Partial (with what is missing) or Not covered. My count matches the strategy view: 20 covered, 58 partial, 46 not covered. The sample table is gone. A few small brief lines have no row of their own (see the minor finding).

criteria.criterion: No file:line or file:range citation points into any file this change edits (CHANGELOG.md, the map, any new or edited doc); those are cited by heading or short quote.
criteria.evidence: Every line-number cite in the map is `BRIEF.md:N`. CHANGELOG.md and README.md are cited by heading (*Unreleased*, the `[0.1.0]` heading, *Quick start*, *Picking up the work*). The strategy view and the roadmap cite no line numbers, and neither does the CHANGELOG entry.

criteria.criterion: Line cites into untouched files (BRIEF.md, docs/records.md, etc.) match the tree, and the map states which files may be cited by line and why.
criteria.evidence: I checked the BRIEF.md cites against the file. Examples: OM-1 at :53 and :95-101 (preflight), A5-3 at :195 (the quote is verbatim), JG-1 at :428, JG-2 at :427, JG-4 at :438 and :441, D3-1 at :363-389, AD-10 at :488-491. All match. Heading cites into other docs also exist: records.md *Following a job from a commit* and *Closing the bootstrap*, enforcement.md rows M1–M23 and *Prose-only in v0*, and decisions D02/D07/D13/D14/D23/D25/D26/D27/D31/D35/D36/D41. The map's *How to cite* section says only BRIEF.md is cited by line, because this work never edits it and addenda are appended at the end.

criteria.criterion: A strategy view (requirements grouped by goal with coverage status) and a roadmap (ordered next steps for partial and uncovered rows, linked to row IDs) exist and are linked from the map.
criteria.evidence: strategy-view.md groups all 124 IDs into goals G1–G8, with per-goal counts (summing to 124/20/58/46) and bets and risks. roadmap.md has 13 ordered steps, RM-1 to RM-13, that list the 104 partial and uncovered rows; my count is 104 = 58 + 46. The map links to both at the top.

criteria.criterion: The CHANGELOG.md Unreleased entry describes the map, strategy view and roadmap, says rows quote or paraphrase the requirement (matching the map's Wording section), and has no line-number cites.
criteria.evidence: The new Unreleased bullet names all three docs. It says "Each row either quotes the brief or paraphrases it, as the map's *Wording* section says" and explains the citation policy. It contains no line numbers.

criteria.criterion: Run git status and git diff --stat: only Markdown under docs/ and CHANGELOG.md (and possibly README.md) changed. Run cargo fmt --check to confirm nothing else is affected.
criteria.evidence: git status reports a clean tree. diff --stat lists only CHANGELOG.md, README.md, docs/design/requirements-map.md, docs/design/roadmap.md and docs/design/strategy-view.md. cargo fmt --check exited 0 with no output.

findings.summary: A few brief lines have no row of their own, even though the map claims every requirement.
findings.evidence: BRIEF.md:56 ("Keep v0 small. Its size is a design choice"), BRIEF.md:400 (scope: M1–M7 required, M8–M9 wanted, "Log anything deferred") and the Settings constraints (BRIEF.md:22-30, e.g. a Rust-compatible web framework for the site) are not cited by any row. The cited ranges and rows around them come close but do not cover them.

findings.summary: There is a wording slip in the Statuses section.

summary: The change does what the retry asked. The requirements map now has 124 ID'd rows across the whole brief, each marked covered, partial or not covered, and it links to a new strategy view (8 goals, with counts I checked add up) and a roadmap (13 ordered steps covering all 104 partial and uncovered rows). The fix for the earlier failure holds: only the unedited BRIEF.md is cited by line, and my spot-check of those cites against the file found them correct. CHANGELOG.md, README.md and the new docs are cited by heading, and the headings and decision IDs cited in other docs exist. The CHANGELOG entry describes all three docs and the quote-or-paraphrase rule, with no line numbers. Only Markdown changed, and cargo fmt --check passes. One minor finding: a few small brief items (keep v0 small, the scope line, the Settings constraints) have no row of their own. One nit: a wording slip in the Statuses section.
